deploy-bot: started canary rollout for telemetry-service release=telemetry-prod chart=telemetry-4.0.0 values=prod-canary.yaml target=10% (2 pods) — will run 30m canary window :rocket:
Frank Liu: seeing postinstall job failing on canary pods, telemetry-migrate is CrashLoopBackOff :frowning: logs attached -> https://logs.internal/telemetry/rollout/1792102460
Ben K: logs show migration tried to run schema migration v2->v3 and failed: ERROR: relation \"sessions\" has no column \"session_hint\"
Ben K: kubectl logs telemetry-migrate-0 -n prod ->
```
> I0320 14:21:03 migration.go:87] starting migration v2->v3
> E0320 14:21:04 migration.go:142] pq: column \"session_hint\" does not exist
> F0320 14:21:04 migration.go:200] migration failed, exiting
```
Carla M: we accidentally flipped enableSessionHints: true in prod-canary values last night when merging the feature flag cleanup PR. That flag triggers the migration path in chart 4.0.0. Oops.
Alice Zhao: can we hotpatch values on the canary to set enableSessionHints=false and keep chart 4.0.0? would that avoid rollback?
Ben K: sadly no — migration hook runs as a helm postinstall job in this chart version, and presence of chart 4.0.0 will run the job regardless of the flag (flag only toggles behavior inside migration code, but chart bumps metadata). Hotpatching values won't prevent the chart's hook from attempting the migration.
Frank Liu: given that, we should rollback to the previous stable chart that doesn't include the migration hook. Suggest telemetry-3.15.2 (image pinned sha256:abc123def456). Anyone object?
Carla M: +1 rollback. We'll also open an immediate values PR to strip the feature flag from prod values and add an explicit preflight check in the canary gate.
Dave Ops: on it — opening PR to pin enableSessionHints=false and add a canary preflight check. I'll also add a test that ensures postinstall hooks exit 0 during canary. PR: https://git.internal/r/ops/telemetry-values/PR-482
Frank Liu: rolling back now. Command I'll run: `helm rollback telemetry-prod 9 --namespace prod && kubectl rollout status deploy/telemetry -n prod --watch` — keeping canary window 15m for verification.
deploy-bot: rollback triggered for telemetry-prod -> target chart=telemetry-3.15.2 image=sha256:abc123def456. Watching canary (10%) for 15m :eyes:
Ben K: after rollback, we'll also mark this release as blocked for automatic retries until values PR is merged and we have a canary preflight that verifies migration jobs succeed.
Dave Ops: created ticket REDWOOD-5471 "canary migration preflight + values pin" and linked PR-482. Assigning to Carla and Ben.
Carla M: followups: 1) backfill a changelog line explaining the migration requirement, 2) add a helm-chart test that simulates postinstall hooks in CI, 3) add an alert on non-zero exit from helm hooks during canary.
deploy-bot: rollback completed, canary stable, health checks passing. Closing rollout 1792102460 and creating incident record "canary-migration-fail" with postmortem task. :white_check_mark:
